comment: Plugin Manager catalog — display metadata for plugins shipped inside the .exe and (eventually) plugins fetched from OblivionPluginRegistry. Edit this file to surface new plugin descriptions without an app release; the loader reads it at startup.  Schema_version is bumped only on breaking field changes — additive changes are allowed without bumping.
